summary: Unstable periodic orbit of two side-by-side cylinders at Re = 62 (flip-flop, T = 8.8152) by Newton-GMRES.
description: Flip-flop orbit (unstable periodic orbit) at Re = 62 by Newton-GMRES, started from the Re = 60 snapshot with the period 8.73356. The Newton iteration changes the period; the converged orbit has T = 8.815129, the time stamp of BF_2cyl0.f00001. The final residual must lie below the Newton tolerance 1e-8. Newton keeps the step count of its first iteration, 1199 steps per period: the time-discrete orbit depends on the step, and runs that chose the count again at each iteration ended at 1212 to 1221 steps, with periods 4e-5 apart. With the kept count the runs with and without a stored orbit (ifstorebase) give periods 4.2e-6 apart. The period and the five statistics of BF_2cyl0.f00001 identify the orbit.

newton_final_residual.note: Final Newton residual (column 7) must not exceed the Newton tolerance (column 8).

orbit_period.note: Period of the converged orbit: the time stamp of the base-flow file. The starting value is 8.73356.

newton_step_count.note: Time steps per period, chosen from the CFL number of the seed at the first Newton iteration and kept for all iterations. Another count gives another time-discrete orbit.
